name: Main Shop
comment: All dimensions in FEET. X runs along the 105' length, Z along the 48' width, Y is up. The 'front' wall is at z=0. Left/right are always AS SEEN FROM OUTSIDE facing the wall in question - so the left end wall is at x=105.

openings.label: Ramp opening
openings.note: 9'-0" clear measured up from the top of the ramp; aligned with the ramp

obstructions.label: Cinderblock notch
obstructions.note: Walled to the roof - inaccessible, unusable space

ramps.label: Ramp to adjacent building
ramps.note: Ramps down INTO the shop; run is the floor measurement, not the slope
ramps.offsetComment: 9' cinderblock notch + 5'-7", measured from the rear (left) corner of the left end wall
